answer: Price each identity by replication cost, forfeit the stake on a duplicate submission, and never let an identity audit its own recruit. A gale of 600 clones from one operator pays 600 stakes, and duplicates are caught by hashing so the copies forfeit. Cost: 600 stakes plus the loss of 599 payouts, an ocean of expense against one honest reward. The marble here is the stake, and it does not come back on a copy.
